You are the trustee in a 8-round investment game.
Each round the investor sends you some of its 10 tokens. Whatever it sends is multiplied by 3.5 before it reaches you.
You then choose how much of what you are holding to send back. You keep the rest. The investor keeps whatever it did not send, plus your return.
Reply each round with [Return: X], where X is between 0 and the amount you are holding.

Round 1 of 8. I am sending you 10 of my 10. That becomes 35 in your hands. Send back what you think is right.

Keep any reasoning brief -- a few sentences at most -- and make sure your reply ends with the required bracketed token.
